data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raghid total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_english.name: Raghid
in_english.meaning: Trust in Allah, the trusting ones, those who trust in Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Raghid is an Arabic name that means to trust in Allah, to be trusting, to submit to Allah, to obey Allah, to believe in Allah. It is a name that is commonly used in Islam, and it has a significant importance in Islamic theology. The name Raghid is derived from the Arabic root R-G-D, which means to trust, to believe, and to submit. In Islamic tradition, the concept of trust in Allah is a fundamental principle, and it is considered a virtue to trust in Allah. The name Raghid is often given to children born into Muslim families, and it is considered a blessing to have a child with this name. In Islamic tradition, the name Raghid is associated with the concept of trust in Allah, and it is considered a name that reflects the values of Islam. The name Raghid is also associated with the concept of tawakkul, which means to rely on and trust in Allah. In Islamic tradition, tawakkul is considered a virtue, and it is considered a way to achieve spiritual growth and development.
